about: What a pass leaves unwired once the integrations that start off are counted. `disabled`
and `enabled` are the exact texts of ~/.agentbar/wire-disabled and ~/.agentbar/wire-enabled
(null: no file); `off` is every id the installers unwire, sorted. Read by
wire-disabled: claude-mod is off unless wire-enabled lists it, and a wire-disabled line wins.

cases.name: a fresh machine: the mod is off, every agent on
wire-disabled saved empty does not switch it on
agents switched off keep the mod off
a wire-disabled line wins over wire-enabled
wire-enabled read by the same rules: case, comments, blanks
listing an agent in wire-enabled changes nothing for it
junk in wire-enabled switches nothing on
